mutations.name: a green factory CI at an older head clears the CI gate
kills: gateStrip reads a green CI at an older head as unmet

mutations.name: a strip with an unknown row is kept and never re-read
mutations.find: if (!timeline.ok || !checkRuns.ok) throw new UnkeptReads({ timeline, checkRuns });
kills: gateStripReader re-reads a strip that had an unknown row

mutations.name: a kept strip is never reused inside its window
kills: gateStripReader reads one PR head at most once per window

mutations.name: the owner's own approve-merge counts as another pending gate
kills: gateStrip a pending ci-failed gate on the PR is an unmet other gate

mutations.name: a kept strip past its window waits for the refresh instead of being served
kills: gateStripReader serves the kept strip past its window while one refresh runs behind it
